/-- **[H, (2.15)]** ([RS62, Thm. 12]): `ψ(y) = ∑_{n ≤ y} Λ(n) < 1.03883 y` for `y > 0`.
Proved from `psi_bounds` (`psi_two_sided` up to `10¹⁷`, `theta_explicit` beyond). -/
theorem sum_vonMangoldt_lt {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, (Λ n : ℝ) < 1.03883 * y := by
  set n := ⌊y⌋₊ with hn
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h0 | hpos
  · rw [h0]; simp; positivity
  have h2 : (n : ℝ) ≤ y := Nat.floor_le hy.le
  rcases le_or_gt n (10 ^ 17) with h | h
  · have h1 := psi_lt_small' hpos h
    unfold psiN at h1
    linarith
  · have h1 := (psi_bounds n).2 (by omega)
    unfold psiN at h1
    have : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    linarith

have hψ : ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (if (n : ℝ) ≤ √x then (Λ n : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1.03883 * √x := by
      rw [← sum_filter]
      have hsub2 : (Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ≤ √x) ⊆ Icc 1 ⌊√x⌋₊ := by
        intro n hn
        have h := mem_filter.1 hn
        exact mem_Icc.2 ⟨(mem_Icc.1 h.1).1, Nat.le_floor h.2⟩
      refine (sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub2 fun n _ _ =>
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg).trans ?_
      exact (Prelim.sum_vonMangoldt_lt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hx0)).le

proof_context.conclusion: Applies the RS62 Thm 12 bound to $\sum_{n\le\sqrt x}\Lambda(n)\le1.03883\sqrt x$ inside the bound for $E$.
